description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git sparse checkout functionality. It includes setup steps, branch creation, sparse checkout configuration, merging, and validation of file existence and contents under different sparse checkout configurations. It also performs operations involving partial clones and fetches, verifying correct behavior of sparse-related features.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given label and commands.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if the specified path exists and is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if the specified path (or file) is missing.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or verifies Git configuration parameters for tests.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository for testing, optionally with a template.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the provided input is empty.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or inputs for equality.
